description: This file defines functions to create and initialize instances of SNApplication with various configurations, including fake and real crypto options, and includes helper functions for setup and launch procedures. It acts as a factory or utility module for application instances.

methods.name: createApplicationWithOptions({ identifier, environment, platform, host, crypto, device })
methods.description: Creates an SNApplication instance with specified options, allowing for custom environments, platforms, cryptography, and device interface.

methods.name: createApplication(identifier, environment, platform, host, crypto)
methods.description: Simplified function that creates an application with default options, delegating to createApplicationWithOptions.

methods.name: createApplicationWithFakeCrypto(identifier, environment, platform, host)
methods.description: Creates an SNApplication instance using a FakeWebCrypto instance for cryptography.

methods.name: createApplicationWithRealCrypto(identifier, environment, platform, host)
methods.description: Creates an SNApplication instance using a real SNWebCrypto instance for cryptography.

methods.name: createAppWithRandNamespace(environment, platform)
methods.description: Creates an application with a random namespace as its identifier.

methods.name: createInitAppWithFakeCrypto(environment, platform)
methods.description: Creates and initializes an application instance with fake cryptography.

methods.name: createInitAppWithRealCrypto(environment, platform)
methods.description: Creates and initializes an application instance with real cryptography.

methods.name: createAndInitializeApplication(namespace, environment, platform, host, crypto)
methods.description: Creates an application and performs asynchronous preparation and launch procedures.

methods.name: initializeApplication(application)
methods.description: Performs readiness checks and launches the application instance.
